name: dashboard
title: Dashboard
description: The signed-in home: TopNav, SideNav rail, page header, dashboard-stats, then a primary table or list and secondary widgets.

frame.summary: The playground's actual shell: sticky TopNav, sticky SideNav rail at control-lg × 6, main column. Widgets are Cards; the activity list is a table/list.

regions.name: header
regions.collapse: Rail → MobileNav drawer at the page's narrow query.

regions.name: rail
regions.collapse: Hidden; same sections render in MobileNav.

regions.name: main
regions.purpose: Page title, stats, primary data, widgets.

budget.wide: 1fr, content capped (playground caps its column; no token)

components.name: search
components.for: Global search; landmark true — the page's one search landmark.

components.name: bottom-nav
components.for: Native phone tab bar in place of the rail.

dependsOnFuture.interim: Main region holds stats and widgets only.
Native uses MobileNav-equivalent drawer — not idiomatic; native ships after bottom-nav.

behavior.summary: The first template with a sidebar, and the one the playground already is. Its shell decisions are the playground's, adopted rather than reinvented.

decisions.why: Sticky header, sticky rail below it at control-lg × 6, main column centred with auto margins — the only precedent, already debugged (the cascade-order bug on the rail's media query is documented in playground.css).

decisions.decision: One breakpoint, owned by the template
decisions.why: Rail ↔ MobileNav at a single narrow query, as use-media-query.ts argues: two breakpoints in one layout read as a bug.

decisions.decision: Two navigation landmarks get distinct names
decisions.why: TopNav "Main" and SideNav named for the area ("Workspace"), per SideNav's contract.

landmarks.label: "Workspace" — or no aside, and the SideNav nav alone
implicit; target of the skip link

headingOutline.content: Stats (visually hidden if no visible title)

obligations: First focusable element is a skip link to <main> — there is no skip-link component, so it is VisuallyHidden content that becomes visible on :focus-visible (open question: promote to a component).

steps.change: Rail hidden; MobileNav trigger in TopNav; widgets one column.

responsive.notes: Rail must hide AFTER its base rule in source order — the playground's documented cascade bug.

native.reason: App template: gets a native version by decision B3. Native is pro tier (decision N6) while the web version stays free; the registry field for that is proposed in docs/platforms.md §3.
native.mapping: Phone: bottom-nav tab bar replaces the rail; each tab is a navigation stack; the dashboard is the first tab's root screen with stats as a 2-column grid. Tablet: sidebar split view.
native.ios: TabView on phone; NavigationSplitView sidebar on iPad.
native.android: NavigationBar on compact, NavigationRail on medium, permanent drawer on expanded window classes.

tokens.rail border: theme.border.default at border.1 on the inline end

tokenGaps.need: A page content max-inline-size (container width) for marketing bands
tokenGaps.interim: The band's content box is capped at calc(var(--rata-size-control-lg) * 32) and centred with auto inline margins; the playground's own column cap is a literal with a comment saying there is no measure token. The container max-width token is sent to the design-tokens interview (gate-1 review); this multiplier is the interim until it lands.

tokenGaps.need: Narrow / medium / wide breakpoint tokens — adopted by decision B2, names and values pending the design-tokens interview
tokenGaps.interim: The block is intrinsic (auto-fill grid, flex-wrap) and needs none. Where a step is unavoidable the page owns the query, as the playground owns its single 60rem NARROW query in use-media-query.ts, until the B2 tokens land.
Composed from visually-hidden; every template needs one, which is the argument for making it a component.

tokenGaps.need: A z-index / layer scale for the sticky header
tokenGaps.interim: The playground uses z-index: 1 with a comment; templates do the same until a layer token exists.
